description: Manage Local Backup Utility of Alpine Linux in run-from-RAM mode.

parameters.name: commit
parameters.description: Control whether to commit changed files. Choices: false true

examples:
# Commit changed files (if any)
- name: Commit
  community.general.lbu:
    commit: true

# Exclude path and commit
- name: Exclude directory
  community.general.lbu:
    commit: true
    exclude:
      - /etc/opt

# Include paths without committing
- name: Include file and directory
  community.general.lbu:
    include:
      - /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
      - /var/lib/misc
